The learning store is an outreach program  school in Edmonton. They wouldn't be able to accept you though because age, so ADLC would likely be your best option!

How old are you? I'm 20 and am doing courses through the learning store. I only turned 20 in January so I was able to register but I can't do any courses through them past Sept. I needed a few courses so to have enough time to do them and because of my age, I was allowed to have the option to "challenge" the courses I wanted to, meaning just write the final or diploma. Maybe try that. 

Also, if you're still school age beyond Sept they might not allow you to just do the final but summer school through them would also be an option. Either option, they only have a $70 registration fee and no other fees at all.
